provenance.ballPolicy: The Moxie-specific separate ball arcs in from the lob, meets her raised right hand at catch frame5/tick10, follows her through the power gather, and releases at frame10/tick21. Ball absent from sprite.
provenance.cleanupNotes: Purple backdrop removed with Moxie local contrast alpha cleanup (Gaussian sigma38px; alpha fade contrast21–42); raw source retained, 15 components isolated during packing.

review.reviewNotes: Fifteen complete Moxie poses in 5x3 row-major. High-lob reach and two-hand overhead catch at frame5/tick10 are clear, then transition into a right-hand power finish and frame10/tick21 release. Human identity, long gold-tied lavender ponytail, adult anatomy and purple/silver kit remain consistent. No ball/pass partner/hoop drawn; cleaned atlas reviewed.

provenance.packaging: package-dunk15.py --isolate-components; 128x96 cells; baseline94; WebP88; no generated extra frames

repack.fit: uniform scale, never upscale; max 86px high and cell width minus 10px; centered horizontally and baseline aligned with 5px bottom clearance

runtimeTrackCalibration.source: human source-cell hand estimate; formulas documented in per-clip layout provenance
runtimeTrackCalibration.notes: Aerial contact points in frames8-10 calibrated from the visible Moxie hand and checked at last carried tick20 in both facings at standard and120% native Canvas zoom. Frame10 ball resolves at the rim on tick21. Raw source ballTrack remains preserved separately.

reviewNotes: Full atlas reviewed on dark and light backgrounds after margin normalization: separated complete human poses, clean alpha, at least5px vertical and horizontal clearance, no crop bleed, Moxie canon and no baked ball.
